data.description:
Record the architectural decision behind three changes to a committed, shared store format plus a
field deletion, so the mixed-version protocol and each rollback boundary are discoverable. session_log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** (measured facts; do not re-derive).

## Content required
- The three committed-format changes — **A2** (`last_get_pass` relocation), **A3** (baseline
  normalization), **A4-2** (prev key-set) — plus the `baseline_advanced_at` deletion (A1).
- Why the cache stays committed on-branch at all (ephemeral GHA runners; epic 6c9c dropped WS-1).
- The mixed-version protocol: write-new / read-`max()` / delete-later, and why `max()` rather than
  first-wins.
- **A2-2's gate** (A2-1 on main >=24h + a `reconcile-bridge.yml` run on a descendant SHA) and why a
  pass-record version stamp could not be used.
- Each rollback boundary: A2-1 reversible, A3 reversible via idempotent read-path canonicalization,
  A2-2 and A4-2 irreversible with their stated preconditions.
- Why assignee is excluded from normalization (data loss via `_assignee_candidates`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] An ADR file exists under `adr/` with the next sequential number, enumerating all three
      committed-format changes, the deletion, the mixed-version protocol, the A2-2 gate, and each
      rollback boundary. Tier: **doc-existence + content check** (grep for each required element).
- [ ] It cites the measured numbers (12.79 -> 1.74 KB marginal; 218/399 identical prev key sets) and
      links session_log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** (measured facts; do not re-derive).
- [ ] `docs/` index and any ADR list are updated so it is reachable. Verify: link check.

## Files
`adr/00XX-bridge-state-format-changes.md`, `adr/README.md` or index

Scope: S. Depends on A3 and A4-2 (so it documents the final shapes).
